run.assistant: Claude (claude.ai, signed-in Pro account, incognito chats, default model Sonnet 5.5, default settings)
run.method: Same 34 questions as the ChatGPT run; one fresh incognito chat per question, one run each. Claude decided itself when to search the web: it searched in 16 of 34 answers (most HCP and accuracy questions; only one patient question).
run.scoring: Same keyword rules as the ChatGPT run for drug mentions, order and studies; accuracy flags checked by hand against labels and sources in the dataset.
run.raw_answers: Full texts are held in the user's Chrome (claude.ai localStorage key 'ibdq_claude'); not copied into the repository.
